method: 20- and 90-second active note/automation scene intervals. Null stream status means not independently observed; Moonlight was used only as a control route. Existing AP12 status lanes read at endpoints; no production trace or runtime changes. Streamed and unstreamed intervals are distinct conditions. These runs do not replace the two required independent maximum-project qualification intervals.
